I changed `src/index.ts` so `label` is the string `"8417"` instead of the number `8417`. That fixes the type error, since it was declared as `string`. Other code that expects `label` to be a number would now be wrong, but `src` contains only this file.

I couldn't run `tsc` to confirm. `node_modules` doesn't exist and TypeScript isn't installed globally, so the command in your request fails with `MODULE_NOT_FOUND`. Run `npm install typescript` first, then run the command again.
